description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Delete a webhook endpoint

Removes an endpoint permanently. Deliveries stop at once and the signing secret is destroyed with the record, so this cannot be undone: registering the same URL again produces a new endpoint with a new secret. If you only want to pause deliveries, set `isActive` to false with a PATCH instead.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.

name: delete_webhook
title: Delete a webhook endpoint
